title: H287: Janus-Q Event-Annotated News Dataset for PEAD Enhancement
rationale: Janus-Q (arXiv:2602.19919) builds a 62,400-article financial news corpus with event type labels, sentiment, and event-driven cumulative abnormal returns (CAR). Their 2-stage supervised+RL framework achieves +102% Sharpe improvement and +17.5% direction accuracy vs LLM baselines. Key insight applicable to H174/PEAD: annotating 8-K/earnings news by event type (earnings beat, guidance raise, guidance cut, restructuring, M&A) and measuring historical CAR per event type enables a more precise entry filter than generic FinBERT score. Current H174 uses FinBERT polarity (positive/negative) but does not distinguish event types. A 'guidance raise' event historically has 2x the post-announcement drift of a 'earnings beat with no guidance change'. Design: (1) Classify H174 8-K text into 10 event types using GPT-4o-mini zero-shot; (2) Compute historical CAR per event type from H174 IS events (2018-2022); (3) In OOS, only enter when event type has mean IS CAR > 5%; (4) Compare OOS WR vs H174 baseline (81.8%). IS 2018-2022, OOS 2023-2025. Gate: OOS WR > 81.8%, n >= 15.
content:

# 3. GuidanceRaise       - Forward guidance raised

# 5. GuidanceInline      - No change to guidance
# 6. MarginExpansion     - Operating margin improvement noted
# 7. RevenueAcceleration - Revenue growth rate accelerating
# 8. Restructuring       - Cost cuts, layoffs, restructuring charges
# 9. MA                  - M&A announcement
# 10. Other              - None of the above
